summary: The manuscript presents NEVO-PEEVA-CERT-1.0, a rigorous machine-checked formal verification and zero-float exact rational certificate suite auditing Dupont García's proof of the Nevo-Peeva conjecture for gap-free edge ideals. Combining an 18-theorem Lean 4 kernel with 0 sorry and an AST-audited Python verifier with 16 canonical certificates and 37 tests, the work establishes exceptional mathematical rigor and correctness.
weaknesses: Technical notation and dense commutative algebra terminology may require deep familiarity with combinatorial graph ideals
